message.reasoning:

I own Tennessee Avenue and Illinois Avenue with $980 cash. p2 rejected a trade for Kentucky Avenue. Building is impossible without monopolies, so I will not mortgage. I am evaluating other trading options.

The orange properties are unowned, so I will wait to buy them myself rather than trade away cash or holdings. p4 has no properties to offer.
